waves.1: Get hired, plus the two catalogues the owner asked for: networking, résumé, job search, the certification census and the country scan

Microsoft AI-103: the final exam and certification name, and whether it has left beta
Microsoft AI-900 (Azure AI Fundamentals), and the AI-300 and AI-200 exams named in the knowledge base's credential guide: names and status
Microsoft DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate): status
Microsoft Applied Skills credentials for generative AI and agents on Azure: names and status
Google Agentic Architect Professional (requester-stated): confirm existence, exact name, exam format and status

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Generative AI Professional and OCI AI Foundations Associate: names, codes and status
IBM watsonx and generative AI certifications: names and status

probes: Re-verify the retirement dates of AWS Machine Learning – Specialty and Microsoft AI-102, and what replaced each.

Announcements between 2026-10-01 and the research date that launch, rename or retire AI certifications at these issuers, including Microsoft Ignite and AWS re:Invent (held in November and December) if they precede the research date.

Partner-programme specialisations that count individual AI certifications (for example the AWS Generative AI Competency, Microsoft's Solutions Partner and AI specialisation rules, and Google Cloud's generative AI specialisation): how many certified individuals each requires.
Free certification challenges, vouchers and India pricing.
How IT-services firms and GCCs in India set certification targets or bonuses for these credentials.
Stacking: does a second or third credential add hiring signal beyond the first, in postings or employer statements?
claims: A certificate is a tie-breaker, and the hiring channel sets its value. It counts most where hiring runs through IT services, staffing agencies, hyperscaler partners and GCC volume programmes, especially when the employer pays; it counts little at product companies and close to nothing at frontier labs and AI-first startups that publish credential-agnostic criteria [B/C, as of 2026-10-21].
No single certification was verified in more than 10% of GenAI job descriptions [B/C].
Published recruiter search strings for AI/ML roles key on titles, languages and frameworks, not certification names [C].

Take a certification only if most of three conditions hold: the target channel rewards it, someone else pays or the hours fit the plan, and the résumé lacks stronger verifiable signals [B/C, a decision rule].
AWS Machine Learning – Specialty had its last exam on 31 March 2026, and Microsoft AI-102 retired on 30 June 2026; the AWS options are MLA-C01 and AIP-C01, and Microsoft's successor is AI-103 [A/B].
AI-103 was still marked beta on its Microsoft Learn exam page [A, as of 2026-10-21].

Take one certification per cloud, at your level: associate level after 6–12 months of hands-on work; professional level (AIP-C01, PMLE) only with 2–3 years of hands-on work or employer sponsorship [P].
Partner programmes count certified individuals towards partner tiers, which is why services firms and partners pay for certifications [A].

sessions.title: Visa and Work-Permit Dossier: United States

claims: O-1A sets no degree, PhD or citation prerequisite: a major award or three of eight criteria, then a final-merits judgement of sustained acclaim [A].
O-1A premium processing costs $2,965 (since 1 March 2026) and takes 15 business days [B].
USCIS publishes only the combined O class: 93.9% approved in FY2025 and 91.0% in FY2026 Q1–Q3; RFEs were reported near 23% in Q3 FY2026 [B].
In the October 2026 Visa Bulletin, India's EB-1 final action date was 1 February 2023, EB-2 1 November 2013 and EB-3 1 January 2014 [B, from law-firm summaries].

The H-1B $100,000 proclamation was extended to 21 September 2027 but struck down by two courts (Massachusetts in June 2026; N.D. California on 30 September 2026, scope unconfirmed); a separate DHS fee proposal of $103,265 (August 2026) was pending [B, re-checked 22 October 2026].
probes: H-1B in full: the cap, the selection process and any weighted-selection rule, the $100,000 proclamation and its litigation, cap-exempt employers (universities and research non-profits), costs, timelines, portability and H-4 work authorisation.
EB-1A and EB-2 National Interest Waiver for AI researchers and engineers: criteria, reported approval rates and timelines.
L-1A and L-1B transfers through multinational employers, a common route for Indian nationals in IT services and GCCs.
Student routes: F-1 OPT and the STEM OPT extension.
Any US investor or 'gold card' programme and its status.
context: It asks readers to re-verify every visa status on its official page within 14 days of acting (decision D-007); contested and pending rules expire 14 days after the date they describe.
Beyond the status of its fees, H-1B was outside the audit behind its visa page, as were EB-2, L-1 and student routes.

probes: Express Entry: category-based draws for STEM and technology occupations, and recent score cut-offs.
The Global Talent Stream: eligible occupations, employer obligations and processing.
Provincial technology streams (for example British Columbia and Ontario).
Intra-company transfers, spousal open work permits and Quebec's separate system.

context: It asks readers to re-verify every visa status on its official page within 14 days of acting (decision D-007); contested and pending rules expire 14 days after the date they describe.

sessions.title: Visa and Work-Permit Dossier: UK, Ireland, Germany, Netherlands, France and Switzerland

params.region: the United Kingdom, Ireland, Germany, the Netherlands, France and Switzerland
claims: UK Global Talent needs no job: an endorsement (one mandatory and two optional criteria, three dated letters, up to ten evidence items) comes before the visa; fees are £766 plus the Immigration Health Surcharge of £1,035 a year [A].
No Exceptional Promise pass rate is published; adviser pages report historical endorsement rates of about 72% across fields and 54–65% for digital technology [C].
A law-firm page reported B2 English for UK settlement applications from 26 March 2027 under HC 1691, while Home Office guidance (v19.0) stated B1 [C, as of 24 September 2026].
The UK's earned-settlement consultation (a 10-year baseline) closed on 12 February 2026 with no government response by 24 September 2026 [C].

Germany's 2026 EU Blue Card floors are €50,700, or €45,934.20 for ICT and shortage roles; ICT specialists without a degree qualify with 3 years' experience in the last 7; with the employer's fast-track the process takes about 2–3 months; settlement can follow after 21 months with B1 German or 27 months with A1 [A; M; B].
Germany's 2027 Blue Card floors had not been published (they are published in December) [as of 22 October 2026].

France's EU Blue Card needs an offer of at least €59,373 and a 3-year degree or 5 years' experience; the minimum contract length was unresolved (6 months in summaries of Decree 2026-308, one year on France-Visas) [A; A/B].

How the title's pay gap with Machine Learning Engineer (about 0.55×) behaves within the same employers.
The shares of agentic, retrieval and evaluation work inside the role.

Classic ML system design against LLM work in interviews.
The pay premium of the title over AI Engineer within the same employers.

The boundary between forward-deployed engineers, solutions architects and applied AI engineers; travel and customer-facing expectations.
